entries.title: Solana relies on elliptic-curve crypto in four places
entries.label: established
entries.threat: Shor breaks Ed25519 and BLS: forged transactions, forged shreds, forged consensus votes
entries.defense: Protocol-level PQ signature scheme plus account migration (not yet scheduled)

sources.title: Anza — Securing Solana Against a Powerful Quantum Adversary (2026-04-27)

entries.title: Exposed-pubkey problem: Solana addresses are Ed25519 public keys
entries.label: established
entries.threat: Every wallet's public key is on-chain from creation; no hash shield before first spend
entries.defense: Address versioning indexing PQ accounts by public-key hash (proposal only)

sources.title: Anza — Securing Solana Against a Powerful Quantum Adversary (2026-04-27)

entries.title: Program vaults cannot protect fee payers
entries.label: established
entries.threat: Fee-payer accounts stay drainable after a CRQC even if funds sit in a PQ vault
entries.defense: Keep fee-payer balances minimal; protocol change needed for a real fix

sources.title: Anza — Securing Solana Against a Powerful Quantum Adversary (2026-04-27)

entries.title: Solana's PQ roadmap is conditional, with no committed scheme or date
entries.label: established
entries.threat: Migration only starts once quantum is judged credible; lead time risk
entries.defense: Research, then PQ scheme for new wallets, then migrate existing wallets

sources.title: Anza — Securing Solana Against a Powerful Quantum Adversary (2026-04-27)

entries.title: Falcon (FN-DSA) is the leading Solana candidate; ML-DSA and SLH-DSA are final NIST standards
entries.label: established
entries.threat: Scheme choice still open; FN-DSA was a draft standard in April 2026
entries.defense: Falcon-512 for compact signatures; ML-DSA-44 as a final-standard fallback

sources.title: Anza — Securing Solana Against a Powerful Quantum Adversary (2026-04-27)

entries.title: SIMD-0461 (Falcon verification syscall) closed unmerged on 2026-06-17
entries.label: established
entries.threat: No native PQ signature verification in the runtime
entries.defense: In-program Falcon verification (~133k-175k CU) instead of a syscall

entries.title: SIMD-0579 Keccak-p1600 syscall reached all approvals on 2026-11-25
entries.label: established
entries.threat: Would cut CU cost of hash-based and Falcon-style verification; not merged or activated yet
entries.defense: Track merge and feature-gate activation; re-benchmark vault costs then

entries.title: Blueshift Winternitz vault: opt-in hash-based protection, unaudited
entries.label: established
entries.threat: Protects only lamports moved into the vault; one-time keys must never be reused; upgrade authority must also be PQ-safe
entries.defense: Candidate cold-treasury vault after independent review

entries.title: Falcon-512 and ML-DSA-44 fit one 4,096-byte v1 transaction; SLH-DSA does not
entries.label: established
entries.threat: SLH-DSA on-chain needs chunking or account-resident signatures
entries.defense: Prefer Falcon-512 or ML-DSA-44 for in-program PQ authorization

entries.title: Anza seed-proof migration prototype merged, but not yet post-Q-day sound
entries.label: likely
entries.threat: Prototype binds sk_seed to pk with an Ed25519 signature, which a quantum adversary could forge
entries.defense: Keep seed phrases for every wallet; wait for an in-circuit version

sources.title: Anza — Securing Solana Against a Powerful Quantum Adversary (2026-04-27)

entries.title: PQ consensus aggregation for Alpenglow is unsolved
entries.label: open
entries.threat: BLS aggregation has no drop-in PQ replacement
entries.defense: Hash-based signatures plus hash-based SNARK aggregation, or Falcon via LaBRADOR (analysis incomplete)

sources.title: Anza — Securing Solana Against a Powerful Quantum Adversary (2026-04-27)

entries.title: Hawk-512 reported broken in a SIMD thread; no primary cryptanalysis found
entries.label: open
entries.threat: Possible broken scheme with an existing SBF implementation
entries.defense: Do not use Hawk until a primary source confirms or refutes the break
